# bullseye

The goal of bullseye is to provide a tidy data structure and
visualisations for multiple or grouped variable correlations, general
association measures and other pairwise scores suitable for numerical,
ordinal and nominal variables.

## Installation

You can install the development version of bullseye from
[GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r
# still in progress
# install.packages("devtools")
# devtools::install_github("cbhurley/bullseye")
```

## Build a `pairwise` data structure

``` r
library(bullseye)
irisc <- pairwise_scores(iris, by = "Species") 
irisc
#> # A tibble: 24 × 6
#>    x            y            score   group      value pair_type
#>    <chr>        <chr>        <chr>   <fct>      <dbl> <chr>    
#>  1 Petal.Length Sepal.Length pearson setosa     0.267 nn       
#>  2 Petal.Width  Sepal.Length pearson setosa     0.278 nn       
#>  3 Sepal.Length Sepal.Width  pearson setosa     0.743 nn       
#>  4 Petal.Length Sepal.Width  pearson setosa     0.178 nn       
#>  5 Petal.Width  Sepal.Width  pearson setosa     0.233 nn       
#>  6 Petal.Length Petal.Width  pearson setosa     0.332 nn       
#>  7 Petal.Length Sepal.Length pearson versicolor 0.754 nn       
#>  8 Petal.Width  Sepal.Length pearson versicolor 0.546 nn       
#>  9 Sepal.Length Sepal.Width  pearson versicolor 0.526 nn       
#> 10 Petal.Length Sepal.Width  pearson versicolor 0.561 nn       
#> # ℹ 14 more rows
```

This calculates correlations for every level of species in the data.

For other methods for calculating pairwise variable scores see the
vignette “Calculating pairwise scores using bullseye”.

## Visualise the correlations

``` r
plot_pairwise(irisc)
```

![](reference/figures/README-vis1-1.png)

The glyph shows the overall or ungrouped correlation in the center, and
the grouped correlations in the wedges. These are setosa, versicolor,
virginica starting from the top and going anti-clockwise. Use

``` r
plot_pairwise(irisc, interactive=TRUE)
```

to see the groups represented by the wedges. The ungrouped Pearson
correlation of Sepal.Width with the other three variables is negative,
but the correlations for each of the Species is positive.

A second visualisation is offered also:

``` r
plot_pairwise_linear(irisc)
```

![](reference/figures/README-vis2-1.png)

For more visualisation examples see the vignette “Visualising pairwise
scores using bullseye”.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`ace_cor()`](https://cbhurley.github.io/bullseye/reference/ace_cor.md)
  : Calculates ace based transformations and correlation, handling
  missing values and factors.

- [`add_nobs_to_pairwise()`](https://cbhurley.github.io/bullseye/reference/add_nobs_to_pairwise.md)
  : Adds number of observations column to pairwise tibble

- [`as.matrix(`*`<pairwise>`*`)`](https://cbhurley.github.io/bullseye/reference/as.matrix.pairwise.md)
  : Converts a pairwise to a symmetric matrix. Uses the first entry for
  each (x,y) pair.

- [`pair_ace()`](https://cbhurley.github.io/bullseye/reference/pair_ace.md)
  : Alternating conditional expectations correlation

- [`pair_cancor()`](https://cbhurley.github.io/bullseye/reference/pair_cancor.md)
  : Canonical correlation

- [`pair_chi()`](https://cbhurley.github.io/bullseye/reference/pair_chi.md)
  : Pearson's Contingency Coefficient for association between factors.

- [`pair_control()`](https://cbhurley.github.io/bullseye/reference/pair_control.md)
  :

  Default scores calculated by `pairwise_scores`

- [`pair_cor()`](https://cbhurley.github.io/bullseye/reference/pair_cor.md)
  : Pearson, Spearman or Kendall correlation

- [`pair_dcor()`](https://cbhurley.github.io/bullseye/reference/pair_dcor.md)
  : Distance correlation

- [`pair_gkGamma()`](https://cbhurley.github.io/bullseye/reference/pair_gkGamma.md)
  : Goodman Kruskal's Gamma for association between ordinal factors.

- [`pair_gkTau()`](https://cbhurley.github.io/bullseye/reference/pair_gkTau.md)
  : Goodman Kruskal's Tau for association between ordinal factors.

- [`pair_kendall()`](https://cbhurley.github.io/bullseye/reference/pair_kendall.md)
  : Kendall's correlation

- [`pair_methods`](https://cbhurley.github.io/bullseye/reference/pair_methods.md)
  : Pairwise score functions available in the package

- [`pair_mine()`](https://cbhurley.github.io/bullseye/reference/pair_mine.md)
  : MINE family values

- [`pair_nmi()`](https://cbhurley.github.io/bullseye/reference/pair_nmi.md)
  : Normalized mutual information

- [`pair_polychor()`](https://cbhurley.github.io/bullseye/reference/pair_polychor.md)
  : Polychoric correlation

- [`pair_polyserial()`](https://cbhurley.github.io/bullseye/reference/pair_polyserial.md)
  : Polyserial correlation

- [`pair_scagnostics()`](https://cbhurley.github.io/bullseye/reference/pair_scagnostics.md)
  : Graph-theoretic scagnostics values

- [`pair_spearman()`](https://cbhurley.github.io/bullseye/reference/pair_spearman.md)
  : Spearman correlation

- [`pair_tauA()`](https://cbhurley.github.io/bullseye/reference/pair_tauA.md)
  : Kendall's tau A for association between ordinal factors.

- [`pair_tauB()`](https://cbhurley.github.io/bullseye/reference/pair_tauB.md)
  : Kendall's tau B for association between ordinal factors.

- [`pair_tauC()`](https://cbhurley.github.io/bullseye/reference/pair_tauC.md)
  : Stuarts's tau C for association between ordinal factors.

- [`pair_tauW()`](https://cbhurley.github.io/bullseye/reference/pair_tauW.md)
  : Kendall's W for association between ordinal factors.

- [`pair_uncertainty()`](https://cbhurley.github.io/bullseye/reference/pair_uncertainty.md)
  : Uncertainty coefficient for association between factors.

- [`pairwise()`](https://cbhurley.github.io/bullseye/reference/pairwise.md)
  [`as.pairwise()`](https://cbhurley.github.io/bullseye/reference/pairwise.md)
  : A generic function to create a data structure for summarising
  variable pairs in a dataset

- [`pairwise_by()`](https://cbhurley.github.io/bullseye/reference/pairwise_by.md)
  : Constructs a pairwise result for each level of a by variable.

- [`pairwise_multi()`](https://cbhurley.github.io/bullseye/reference/pairwise_multi.md)
  : Calculates multiple scores

- [`pairwise_scores()`](https://cbhurley.github.io/bullseye/reference/pairwise_scores.md)
  : Calculates scores or conditional scores for a dataset

- [`plot(`*`<pairwise>`*`)`](https://cbhurley.github.io/bullseye/reference/plot.pairwise.md)
  :

  Plot method for class `pairwise`.

- [`plot_pairwise()`](https://cbhurley.github.io/bullseye/reference/plot_pairwise.md)
  : Pairwise plot in a matrix layout

- [`plot_pairwise_linear()`](https://cbhurley.github.io/bullseye/reference/plot_pairwise_linear.md)
  : Pairwise plot in a linear layout
